item.title: Snippets 1.3
item.description:
• Expand any live preview to fill the window, with its parameters docked below.
  • Snippets open out of the card you click and close back into it.
  • Rounder, concentric corners on the snippet card and the welcome tour.
  • Copying code from inside Snippets no longer offers to save it again.

item.title: Snippets 1.2
item.description:
• Code in a snippet's detail view is syntax-highlighted again, and the editor keeps its colours as soon as it opens.
  • When a new version is available, an update button appears in the top bar of your library; click it to see what's new and install.

item.title: Snippets 1.1.1
item.description:
• If your library can't be opened, Snippets now explains what happened and offers recovery from a backup instead of crashing.
  • Snippets asks before importing a .snippets file opened from outside the app.
  • Replaced or changed code no longer keeps the preview trust it had before.
  • Attachment changes in the editor apply on save, and Discard cleans them up.

item.title: Snippets 1.1
item.description:
Snippets 1.1

  • In-app updates. Snippets can now tell you when a new version is out and install it for you. The second time you open the app, it asks whether to check automatically.
  • Check for Updates… in the Snippets menu, and a new Updates section in Settings ▸ General with an on/off switch and Check Now.

Each update check downloads a list of versions from this site. The privacy policy describes exactly what that request shares.
